2026_01_CLE_JAX.headline: Cleveland’s rebuilt line gets an immediate Jacksonville stress test
2026_01_CLE_JAX.paragraph1: Cleveland starts Deshaun Watson behind a rebuilt offensive line that will already be without guard Teven Jenkins, with rookie Austin Barber set for his first start and center Parker Brailsford questionable. Jacksonville has moving pieces up front too, including a reshuffled offensive line and uncertainty at right tackle, so neither offense can treat protection as settled. Trevor Lawrence has the cleaner continuity at quarterback, while Cleveland needs Watson to avoid negative plays. Interior pressure, third-down execution and protection communication should decide which offense settles first.
2026_01_CLE_JAX.model_rationale: Jacksonville has the steadier quarterback environment, while Cleveland’s upset path depends on surviving its offensive-line transition and creating enough defensive disruption to shorten Lawrence’s possessions.
